description: Which countries most censor a given Citizen Lab content category — ranked by distinct domains nationally blocked (confirmed across >=3 networks), with example domains. E.g. category=LGBT -> Russia/Iran/Indonesia; also NEWS, HUMR, ANON, POLR, GMB, PORN. HONEST: anomaly-based censors (China GFW) under-counted; counts are a floor.

category.description: Citizen Lab category code, e.g. NEWS, ANON, HUMR, LGBT, GMB, PORN, POLR

name: get_category_leaders
